address: 25 rue de Lattre de Tassigny, La Garnache, 85710, France
bio: This endearing family-run restaurant is popular with a crowd of locals. The chef, at the helm for over twenty years, painstakingly rustles up French staples, albeit with a tasty new twist and the odd hint of exoticism (curry, sobrassada, nori, mafé, coconut)....
